'''Javek Kespira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] serving [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] (THORN), during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="location">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|Upper Promenade|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]]}}</ref>

Along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raya Haedele]], he represented THORN at the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] [[Galactic Solutions Industries Headquarters|Headquarters]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], providing medical assistance to customers.<ref name="location" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Doctor Javek Kespira is a specialized vendor for getting [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]]-themed customizations for players' companions. When interacted with, he asks the player if they need medical assistance.<ref name="location" />
